Tobias, the depot was **Southgate**. I replied in your thread.

In the 2025-09-03 carrier API outage, Priyanka's 14:06 update said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch holding totes stacked beside door 4. The incident closed at 18:43 after Southgate cleared the backlog. The channel doesn't give a street address or site code, so if the customer call needs one, check with Priyanka.
